description: Write one Markdown note per video into a folder of an Obsidian vault on this machine: frontmatter properties, chapters as headings, paragraphs prefixed with [m:ss] timestamp links, plus an index note with [[wikilinks]] when a collection is exported. Notes vid2context wrote before are updated; other existing notes are never replaced unless overwrite is true.

collection.description: A saved collection id to export

folder.description: Folder inside the vault. Default: the collection name, or "vid2context"

overwrite.description: Replace existing notes not written by vid2context for the same video. Default false

urls.description: Video, playlist, channel or feed URLs to export

vaultPath.description: Absolute path of the vault (or any folder) to write into

name: export_obsidian
title: Export to an Obsidian vault
